import json
OUT = "/tmp/obench-cell-siixefkd/bench_opencode_regex-chess_tupy06fi/re.json"
R = []
def add(p, r): R.append([p, r])
G = r"[^ \n]"
def g(n):
    return "" if n == 0 else (G if n == 1 else G + "{%d}" % n)
def path(s, d):  # gap of s*d-1 chars, intermediates empty
    return (("(?:%s\\.)" % g(s-1)) + ("{%d}" % (d-1) if d > 2 else "") if d > 1 else "") + g(s-1)
TAIL = r"(%s*)( [^ \n]+) [^ \n]+$" % G
TGT = "[.pnbrq]"
PRE = r"([^*\n]*)"

def fwd(o, gap, piece, newpiece, tgt=TGT):
    # target at p+o
    add(r"(?m)^!%s\*(%s)(%s)%s%s" % (PRE, piece, gap, tgt, TAIL),
        "\\g<0>\nM\\1.\\3%s\\4\\5 -" % newpiece)
def bwd(o, gap, piece, newpiece, tgt=TGT, pre=PRE, ep="-"):
    add(r"(?m)^!%s%s(%s)\*(%s)%s" % (pre, tgt, gap, piece, TAIL),
        "\\g<0>\nM\\1%s\\2.\\4\\5 %s" % (newpiece, ep))

# ---- parse
add(r"^(\S+) w (\S+) (\S+).*$", r"@>\1/ \2 \3")
for d in range(8, 0, -1):
    add("%d(?=\\S* )" % d, "." * d)
add("/", "//")
# ---- one copy per white piece, with '*' marker before it
for _ in range(16):
    add(r"(?m)^@([^>\n]*)>([^PNBRQK \n]*)([PNBRQK])(.*)$", "@\\1\\2\\3>\\4\n!\\1\\2*\\3\\4")
# ---- moves
for s, cls in [(1, "[RQ]"), (10, "[RQ]"), (9, "[BQ]"), (11, "[BQ]")]:
    for d in range(1, 8):
        fwd(s*d, path(s, d), cls, r"\2")
        bwd(s*d, path(s, d), cls, r"\3")
for o in (8, 12, 19, 21):
    fwd(o, g(o-1), "N", "N"); bwd(o, g(o-1), "N", "N")
for o in (1, 9, 10, 11):
    fwd(o, g(o-1), "K", "K"); bwd(o, g(o-1), "K", "K")
# pawns
bwd(10, g(9), "P", "P", tgt=r"\.", pre=r"([^*\n]{10,})")
bwd(10, g(9), "P", "Q", tgt=r"\.", pre=r"([^*\n]{0,7})")
for o in (9, 11):
    bwd(o, g(o-1), "P", "P", tgt="[pnbrq]", pre=r"([^*\n]{10,})")
    bwd(o, g(o-1), "P", "Q", tgt="[pnbrq]", pre=r"([^*\n]{0,7})")
for f in range(8):
    bwd(20, path(10, 2), "P", "P", tgt=r"\.", pre=r"([^*\n]{%d})" % (40+f), ep="abcdefgh"[f] + "3")
    t = 20 + f; nm = "abcdefgh"[f] + "6"
    if f >= 1:
        add(r"(?m)^!(%s)\.(%s)\*Pp(%s*)( [^ \n]+) %s$" % (g(t), g(8), G, nm), "\\g<0>\nM\\1P\\2..\\3\\4 -")
    if f <= 6:
        add(r"(?m)^!(%s)\.(%s)p\*P(%s*)( [^ \n]+) %s$" % (g(t), g(9), G, nm), "\\g<0>\nM\\1P\\2..\\3\\4 -")
# castling
add(r"(?m)^!(%s)\*K\.\.R(%s*)( [^ \n]*K[^ \n]*) [^ \n]+$" % (g(74), G), "\\g<0>\nC\\1KKK.\\2\\3 -")
add(r"(?m)^!(%s)R\.\.\.\*K(%s*)( [^ \n]*Q[^ \n]*) [^ \n]+$" % (g(70), G), "\\g<0>\nD\\1..KKK\\2\\3 -")
# ---- legality
alts = []
for o in (8, 12, 19, 21):
    alts += ["K%sn" % g(o-1), "n%sK" % g(o-1)]
alts += ["p%sK" % g(8), "p%sK" % g(10), "Kk", "kK", "K%s{8,10}k" % G, "k%s{8,10}K" % G]
for s, cls in [(1, "[rq]"), (10, "[rq]"), (9, "[bq]"), (11, "[bq]")]:
    st = "(?:%s\\.)*%s" % (g(s-1), g(s-1))
    alts += ["K%s%s" % (st, cls), "%s%sK" % (cls, st)]
add(r"(?m)^[MCD](?=%s*?(?:%s))" % (G, "|".join(alts)), "X")
add(r"(?m)^[X@!].*(?:\n|\Z)", "")
add(r"\n+\Z", "")
add(r"(?m)^C(%s)KKK\." % g(74), r"M\1.RK.")
add(r"(?m)^D(%s)\.\.KKK" % g(70), r"M\1..KR.")
for idx, ch, lets in [(74, "K", "KQ"), (77, "R", "K"), (70, "R", "Q"), (7, "r", "k"), (0, "r", "q")]:
    for L in lets:
        add(r"(?m)^(M(?=%s[^%s])%s [^ \n]*)%s" % (g(idx), ch, g(80), L), r"\1")
add(r"(?m)^(M%s)  " % g(80), r"\1 - ")
add(r"(?m)^M" + ("(%s)//" % g(8)) * 8 + r" (\S+) (\S+)$", "/".join("\\g<%d>" % i for i in range(1, 9)) + r" b \g<9> \g<10> 0 1")
for d in range(8, 0, -1):
    add(r"\.{%d}" % d, str(d))
json.dump(R, open(OUT, "w"))
print(len(R), len(set(p for p, _ in R)), sum(len(a)+len(b) for a, b in R))
